notes: Added the namespaced Yellowdawg Supabase catalog schema and public read views expected by MusicVerse.
Added the protected musicverse_import_catalog_v1 RPC for repeat-safe catalog imports.
Recording identity now preserves permanent MusicVerse aliases and can converge on verified Spotify track IDs without depending on editable display text.
The catalog importer is non-destructive: repeated imports update known records and do not delete records omitted from a later snapshot.
Added migration contract tests for required views, service-role protection, and non-destructive behavior.
No catalog data is imported by this release until the Yellowdawg migration is applied.
